tinier_data.supports: Dataset-specific window durations for WISDM, UCI, HAPT, USC-HAD, MotionSense and UTD-MHAD-W.

tinier_train.supports: Standardization, natural sampling, Adam .001 and the TinierHAR training schedule.

tinier_window.supports: Half-window displacement in the time-domain loader.

tinier_normalize.supports: Standardization and min-max normalization implementations; min-max is a candidate, not the training default.

augmentation.supports: Wearable-signal augmentation mechanisms; candidate strengths/probabilities below are local hypotheses unless noted.

paper.supports: Benchmark architecture families, dataset scope and source-only selection. Does not disclose an exact initial pipeline per dataset.

adaptations: Time duration preserved while resampling to the protected 50 Hz; source-only fitted statistics and person-isolated validation replace author evaluation splits.
Rotation and min-max candidates are local combinations of cited methods, not reported optimal pipelines.
Model settings use the pinned architecture presets; channel count follows the fixed task.
The second architecture uses a local 1-second comparison window to test temporal context and accommodate shorter recordings; this is not an author-reported optimum.
